extract_zip_archive: extract a zip archive to an output directory using the extract.py bot script
extract_tar_gz_archive: extract a tar.gz archive to an output directory using the extract.py bot script
extract_tar_bz2_archive: extract a tar.bz2 archive to an output directory using the extract.py bot script
extract_archive_no_prefix: extract an archive without removing the top-level directory prefix using the --no-prefix flag
check_archive_digest: check if an archive has already been extracted by comparing its sha256 digest
